scope: Windows PowerShell 5.1, machine policy, native plaintext 4104 ScriptBlockText only
limitations: READY means scoped telemetry capability, not rule correctness, forwarding, backend translation or detection effectiveness.
PowerShell 7, other providers, user-only policy and arbitrary normalized fields are not assessed.
Newest matching event only, within 24 hours; absence of an event is not evidence of disabled logging.
Current policy and historical observation are not an atomic snapshot; running sessions may cache earlier policy.
No guarantee of complete capture, script-fragment reassembly or resistance to tampering; encrypted content is unresolved.
